title: DSC 106 Project 2 - Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: We analyze and visualize supporting and opposing arguments around whether states with fewer abortion clinics tend to have lower abortion rates. The sides of the argument are each given a visualization and we then discuss the aspects of those visuals that are persuasive, deceptive, and the what the boundary is between these two concepts. The github pages is here: https://ndjapri.github.io/dsc106-project2/

title: DSC 80 Project - Spotify Music Popularity Analysis
description: Analyzed 114,000 Spotify tracks to investigate how audio characteristics influence popularity across music genres. Used hypothesis testing, feature engineering, and random forest regression to reduce prediction error by 27.9% compared to a linear regression baseline, presenting findings through a Jekyll-based website. The github pages is here: https://arcpro00.github.io/music-popularity-analysis/

title: DSC 106 Project 1 - Protein Cost-Effectiveness vs. Food Processing
description: Developed a Tableau visualization using a simplified GroceryDB dataset to investigate the relationship between food processing levels and protein cost-effectiveness. Cleaned and transformed nutritional data, removed outliers using the IQR method, and visualized trends suggesting that less processed foods provide more protein per dollar on average.
